sources.coverage: Twelve profiles establish all fifteen exact DKBW identities.
sources.scope: Long-term profiles and historical classification language, not current warning observations.
sources.access: Normal browser reads succeeded. Direct HTML GETs of thirteen municipal list/beach pages returned 403 from this runner; not proof of a global outage. No bypass attempted.
sources.reuse: No redistribution licence for profile text established; only identifiers, short factual summaries and links retained.

sources.coverage: 18 table rows; 15 matched by names to exact-ID municipal profiles. Ans Søbred, Laven and Søgade are outside this batch.
sources.freshness: Latest selected samples 2026-08-15 or 2026-08-17; seasonal June-August monitoring, not current temperature/safety.
sources.limits: Bacterial classification excludes cyanobacteria. No stable documented unattended API, reuse terms or rate contract verified. No internal Power BI query API reverse-engineered.
sources.normalization: Keep sample date separate from fetch time, preserve <15 qualifiers. The Udmærket label must not overwrite the catalogue annual_classifications. No static sample imported as fresh.
sources.nextStep: Use an official published export/API when available, with date precision, censoring and advice semantics tested. A current warning must be distinct from seasonal microbiology.

sources.format: JSON array of TimeStampLocal, Location, Temperature strings
sources.license: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal, displayed for each resource by the publisher.
sources.authentication: Five documented public GET endpoints returned 200 without credentials.
sources.coverage: Catalogue lists six lake resources. Five relevant resources probed once; Tange Sø omitted because outside this batch. Sensors at Bryrup Søbad, De Små Fisk, Virklund Søbad and Søsportens Hus are place candidates. Almindsø sensor is mid-lake at the deepest point. No station is assigned to another beach merely because it shares a lake.
sources.units: Water temperature at 0.5 m depth; published temperatures interpreted as degrees Celsius, require explicit unit convention confirmation before adapter activation.
sources.frequency: Publisher says continuous; actual latest results are January/March 2024. HTTP success is not evidence of fresh measurements.
sources.rateLimits: At most 5000 data points per call documented; request-rate limit not documented. Only latest-value GETs used.
sources.timestampCaveat: Field named TimeStampLocal contains a Z suffix. Preserve raw timestamps; resolve local/UTC naming conflict before normalization. It cannot change the stale result: all samples are over two years old.
sources.nextStep: Recheck for resumed data or an officially documented replacement. Do not schedule daily retries of unchanged stale endpoints. If restored, use shared collector adapter and station targets, explicit freshness/unknown states and tests; do not add per-location UI logic.

sources.finding: Municipal announcement says Water Web Tools app closed December 17, 2025 and directs users to the municipal beach page. Current Almind-Wellet page says the municipality no longer offers realtime measurement. Den blå tap page contains an iframe but no readable current value/date in the inspected browser. No replacement API verified. Site header clock is not an observation timestamp.

sources.scope: Complete station listing screened. No returned station in lon 9.3–9.8 / lat 55.9–56.4 around the selected lakes. Ocean/tide observations are not lake observations; no nearest marine station substitution. This is not a claim about every DMI dataset.
sources.weather: Existing per-site Open-Meteo weather model passed for all 15. No new DMI wind or warning mapping enabled.

validation.production: 4 lake/coastal pagination pages, 15 exact location/observation identities and 15 valid weather responses. All 15 report marineModelSupported=false and 0 dynamic observation items; this is existing coverage, not a new integration.
validation.research: 15 unique new registry IDs, 15 exact profile IDs and historical sample rows; 5 actual stale JSON API responses; 201 DMI stations plus empty final page.
